key.decision_why: The author did both things laurynmm asked for and the PR has no assigned maintainer, so a triager needs a short note to move it out of "not ready". The PR only shrank by dropping the docs commit, so the first card still describes it correctly.
key.action_why: On 2026-10-05 laurynmm removed "not ready", added "priority: low" and requested a review from Vector73, the last person to work on this area.
changed: The author force-pushed rewritten commit messages for both rename commits, aiming to follow the commit message guidelines.
The Home Assistant docs commit and zerver/webhooks/homeassistant/doc.md were removed from this PR.
The docs fix was moved to a separate PR, #40197, which the author says has before/after screenshots.
The PR now holds only the DEFAULT_AVATAR_URI and DEFAULT_LOGO_URI renames, and the author says the code is unchanged.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for splitting out the docs fix and rewriting the commits, and say the PR is going to a reviewer for the settings renames, which may take a while.

must_have.fact: Says both asks from laurynmm are done: the commit messages were rewritten in a new push, and the Home Assistant docs change was moved out to #40197 with screenshots.
Gives the next step as handing off for review: remove "not ready", add a review label and request a reviewer, rather than asking for more changes.
Suggests Vector73 as the reviewer, since they wrote the earlier merged URI→URL PRs (#29959, #30367) for #23380.
Notes that the code itself is unchanged since the first look: the same two rename commits, with old-name fallbacks in computed_settings.py and tests.
Notes that renaming server settings is an admin-facing change where backward compatibility for existing /etc/zulip/settings.py files matters, so it needs a careful reviewer.
